ground_truth.title: Weekly Engineering Standup & Sprint Planning
ground_truth.reference_transcript: Alice: Good morning everyone, let's start our sprint check-in. Bob, how are things looking on the database optimization? Bob: Morning Alice. I noticed query response times on the meetings list have climbed under concurrent load. I propose adding composite indexes to the meetings and action items tables. I will implement and test these composite indexes by Friday, October 25th. Alice: That sounds critical, approved. Charlie, what is the status of the analytics dashboard? Charlie: The dashboard is functioning well, but there is an accessibility issue with text contrast on the responsive charts in dark mode. I will fix the responsive chart contrast by Thursday, October 26th. Alice: Great. Next item: we decided to enable automatic local storage fallback whenever our cloud storage provider returns a paused status or errors out, so uploads never fail. Does everyone agree? Bob: Yes, agreed. Charlie: Agreed. Also, we will keep audio chunk duration set to 10 minutes to respect Whisper limits. Alice: Wonderful. Finally, I will draft the release notes for our v1 baseline deployment by Monday, October 28th. Let's get to work.

decisions.decision: Enable automatic local storage fallback whenever cloud storage is paused or fails
decisions.rationale: Ensures meeting uploads never fail even when free-tier cloud storage services are paused

decisions.decision: Set audio chunking duration to 10 minutes
decisions.rationale: Keeps chunk payloads well below Whisper 25 MB per-request limit
